integrity: Analytic invariant-density and harmonic-coordinate proofs, plus independently constructed tilted reset-time chain with finite numerical checks; no third-party independent validation.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional homogeneous Brownian diffusion with instantaneous nearest-site resets from a homogeneous Poisson process and a deterministic periodic site array. Full finite-time position distributions, arbitrary renewal clocks and mobile/disordered nonperiodic arrays are outside the theorem. Publication-priority uniqueness is not certified; exact regular-array effective diffusivity and globally rate-optimized regular-arrangement superiority are acknowledged prior results.
title: Exact transport in nonuniform arrays of nearest-site resetting points
